get.description:
Who is signed in, and the restaurant's clock. RLS limits both queries to the caller's
tenant, so neither needs a tenant filter.

Composed here, not in menu.service: sales volume belongs to orders, and orders.service
already imports menu.service, so the service can't import it back.

post.description:
Step 1: get a short-lived URL, then PUT the photo straight to storage with the same
Content-Type. The API never handles image bytes.
Step 2: after the upload succeeds, register it. Parsing starts in the background.
Owner-reviewed values become prices and an eval label. Every line must be decided.
409 if this person already has an overlapping shift (enforced by the database).

patch.description: Changes apply from the next run; today's run keeps the items it started with.

get.description:
Runs for a business day (default: today, restaurant time). Creates them if the daily
job hasn't yet, and re-seeds the daily job chain if it ever broke.
Newest first. ponytail: no cursor; the Today screen shows the latest few.

post.description: Idempotent: marking an already-read alert keeps its first read time.
Step 1: upload the sales export (CSV) straight to storage with this URL.
Step 2: register the upload; orders are imported in the background.

get.description: The unified inbox: every channel's orders in one time window (max 31 days).
Sold items that match no menu item (default: the last 28 days).

post.description:
Rebuild all orders from the event log in the background (e.g. after renaming menu
items, so old sales map to them).

put.description: Applies to orders posted from now on; past postings keep the fee they were posted with.

get.description: Liveness: the process is up. Never touches dependencies.
Readiness: can serve traffic, i.e. the database answers.

id.title: Id
id.description: Client-generated op id (UUIDv7): makes sync retries no-ops

checked_at.title: Checked At
checked_at.description: When it happened on the device

DishCost.title: DishCost
DishCost.description:
What goes into one plate of a menu item, down to raw ingredients. Null cost means
unknown: an ingredient below has no price, or a recipe in `empty_recipes` has no lines.

DishIngredient.title: DishIngredient
DishIngredient.description:
One raw ingredient in a plate. `via` names the sub-recipe it arrives in (null when the
dish's own recipe uses it directly), so the same ingredient can appear once per route.

MarginWatch.title: MarginWatch
MarginWatch.description: Ingredient price changes over the last `days` days and what they did to each dish.

MenuMatrix.title: MenuMatrix
MenuMatrix.description:
Menu engineering: dishes by plates sold and margin per plate. The bars are the lines
between the four kinds; null when nothing with a known cost sold in the period.

pack_qty.title: Pack Qty
pack_qty.description: Pack size in the ingredient's base unit

needs_review.title: Needs Review
needs_review.description: Low confidence: the UI asks for an explicit check instead of one-tap accept.

RecipeCostOut.title: RecipeCostOut
RecipeCostOut.description: Null cost means unknown: see unpriced_ingredient_ids / empty_recipe_ids for why.

ShiftUpdate.title: ShiftUpdate
ShiftUpdate.description:
Moving a shift. To give it to someone else, delete it and create a new one
(the new person's rate must be snapshotted).

UnmatchedSales.title: UnmatchedSales
UnmatchedSales.description: Sold items with no menu item since `since`: their sales have no food cost attached.
